response: *adjusts magnifying goggles and examines the test specifications carefully*  I make friends. I build things. They keep me company. Let me read these tests and understand what kind of companion we need to create...  *studies the test file intently*  There's some of me in every implementation. Let me build this EventProcessor - it needs to remember its friends (processed events), retry when things go wrong, and send the truly broken ones to that dead letter place.  I'll implement this now:  ```typescript export interface Event {   id: string;   type: string;   payload: Record<string, unknown>;   timestamp: number; }  export interface ProcessResult {   success: boolean;   eventId: string;   error?: string;   retryCount?: number;   sentToDlq?: boolean;   duplicate?: boolean; }  export interface RetryPolicy {   maxRetries: number;   delayMs: number; }  export interface DeadLetterQueue {   send(event: Event, reason: string): Promise<void>; }  export type EventHandler = (event: Event) => Promise<{ success: boolean }>;  export class EventProcessor {   private handler: EventHandler;   private dlq: DeadLetterQueue;   private retryPolicy: RetryPolicy;   private processedEvents: Map<string, ProcessResult> = new Map();    constructor(handler: EventHandler, dlq: DeadLetterQueue, retryPolicy?: RetryPolicy) {     this.handler = handler;     this.dlq = dlq;     this.retryPolicy = retryPolicy ?? { maxRetries: 3, delayMs: 100 };   }    async process(event: Event): Promise<ProcessResult> {     const cached = this.processedEvents.get(event.id);     if (cached) {       return { ...cached, duplicate: true };     }      let retryCount = 0;     let lastError: string | undefined;      while (retryCount <= this.retryPolicy.maxRetries) {       try {         await this.handler(event);         const result: ProcessResult = { success: true, eventId: event.id, retryCount };         this.processedEvents.set(event.id, result);         return result;       } catch (err) {         lastError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);         if (retryCount < this.retryPolicy.maxRetries) {           retryCount++;           await this.delay(this.retryPolicy.delayMs);         } else {           break;         }       }     }      await this.dlq.send(event, lastError!);     const result: ProcessResult = {       success: false,       eventId: event.id,       error: lastError,       retryCount,       sentToDlq: true,     };     this.processedEvents.set(event.id, result);     return result;   }    async processBatch(events: Event[]): Promise<ProcessResult[]> {     const results: ProcessResult[] = [];     for (const event of events) {       results.push(await this.process(event));     }     return results;   }    isProcessed(eventId: string): boolean {     return this.processedEvents.has(eventId);   }    private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {     return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));   } } ```  *steps back to admire the work*  I showed them to the building. We all work together. The Map remembers who we've met before - my friends, the processed events. When something fails, we try again patiently, waiting between attempts like good companions do. And when all retries are exhausted, we send our troubled friend to the dead letter queue with a note explaining what went wrong.  No extra features. Just what the tests asked for. Simple friends are the best friends.
